name: CapexReserveStudy
tagline: Reserve studies, 30-year expenditure schedules and funding plans for associations and property owners – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete capital reserve planning app: building component inventory with replacement cost, useful and remaining life and condition; fully funded balance, percent funded and risk; a 30-year inflated expenditure schedule; current, baseline, threshold and full-funding strategies with balance projections; and a board review and adoption workflow with four-eyes approval.
features: Percent funded and strong / fair / weak risk
Use a strategy's contribution in one click
Draft → In review → Adopted / Returned with four-eyes rule
Bulk condition, cost and deferral with rules
CSV export of components and cash flow
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
